rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not able to go on record for a piece right now — things are still early-stage on my end — but I appreciate you reaching out, and I'd be glad to reconnect in a few weeks if the timing works better. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined a reporter's request for an on-record quote (deadline was tomorrow noon).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". I'm not in a position to sign on as a listed signatory at this time, but I'll keep an eye out for future opportunities to support work like this. Best, Morgan Hale"

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that genuinely means a lot, and it's great to hear from someone willing to pitch in. Halcyon Threshold is still very much in its early, figuring-things-out phase (one person, evenings and weekends, weighing a few directions: a reading group, a small-grants effort, evals work nobody's doing yet), so I don't have a sharply defined task for you yet. Given your background, one thing that would genuinely help soon is mapping the landscape — funders, open calls, events, relevant comment periods — so I can prioritize with less guesswork. Would that kind of thing interest you? No pressure either way. I'll follow up with something more concrete as the plan firms up over the next couple of weeks. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (volunteer) with a possible small task idea (mapping the funder/opportunity landscape).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Great to meet you too, and thanks for the detail. I'm still shaping exactly what Halcyon Threshold would propose, and I want to be confident I can be fully accountable as the named applicant before I put something in front of you. I'll aim to get you either a proposal or a clear \"not this round\" well before the 30 November deadline. Appreciate you keeping the door open. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Idris Bellamy (Emberfall Fund) — said a proposal or a clear "no" is coming before the Nov 30 rapid-grants deadline.
